categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three business segments: gene sequencing instruments, laboratory automation, and new business sectors including multi-omics tools, ultrasound imaging platforms, and ultra-low temperature automated biobanks. The gene sequencing segment leads the industry with a comprehensive product matrix covering short-read and long-read sequencing technologies. Laboratory automation focuses on intelligent upgrades integrating AI to enhance efficiency and data-driven decision-making. The new business segment develops products in cellomics, spatial omics, proteinomics, and imaging, expanding applications in research and clinical fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary DNBSEQ sequencing technology, semiconductor imaging sensors integrated with AI, and unique sequencing chemistries such as StandardMPS 2.0 and CoolMPS. The company employs advanced manufacturing processes for sequencing chips, reagents, and instruments, with global production bases ensuring supply chain security. Laboratory automation leverages AI-driven robotic platforms and digital twin technologies for workflow optimization. The company also develops multi-omics library preparation techniques, microfluidics, and automated sample processing systems, emphasizing in-house R&D and patent protection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include research institutions, clinical laboratories, agricultural genomics centers, public health agencies, and industrial biotech companies. The company serves global markets with applications spanning large-scale population genomics, clinical diagnostics (e.g., oncology, infectious diseases), molecular breeding, environmental monitoring, and forensic science. It supports both B2B customers such as sequencing service providers and OEM partners, as well as end-users in hospitals and research labs. The company also targets emerging markets in spatial and single-cell omics, precision medicine, and remote medical imaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with operations and subsidiaries across China (Shenzhen, Wuhan, Changchun, Qingdao, Kunshan, Hangzhou), Hong Kong, the United States, Japan, Latvia, Germany, Singapore, the Netherlands, Serbia, Australia, Brazil, New Zealand, and South Korea. It maintains 9 R&D centers, 7 production bases, 9 international spare parts warehouses, and 13 customer experience centers worldwide. Sales and marketing teams cover over 110 countries and regions across six continents, with a strong presence in China, Asia-Pacific, Europe, Africa, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the gene sequencing and laboratory automation supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and sells sequencing instruments, reagents, and automation equipment. The company has achieved core raw material and key component self-sufficiency, reducing reliance on foreign suppliers. It also provides integrated solutions including software and data analysis platforms, positioning itself as a comprehensive provider of life science core tools and services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing full-read-length sequencing technology (SEQ ALL), expanding ultra-high throughput and compact sequencing platforms, and integrating AI deeply into life science tools. The company focuses on multi-omics integration, intelligent laboratory automation (GLI business), and expanding applications in clinical, agricultural, environmental, and public health domains. R&D efforts emphasize proprietary sequencing chemistries, hardware innovation, reagent development, and software for bioinformatics acceleration. The company also invests in global standard setting, intellectual property protection, and sustainable manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of gene sequencing instruments, laboratory automation equipment, and consumable reagents. The company employs both direct sales and distributor channels globally. It also earns income from providing after-sales maintenance, technical support, and software services. Revenue streams include product sales, service contracts, and licensing of proprietary technologies. The company’s business model integrates hardware, consumables, and software to create recurring revenue opportunities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in gene sequencing instruments, competing with major international players such as Illumina and Thermo Fisher. It holds a significant market share in China and is expanding internationally. The company differentiates itself by offering both short-read and long-read sequencing platforms with proprietary technologies, achieving competitive pricing and high accuracy. It is recognized as one of the few companies with large-scale commercial production capabilities for diverse sequencing technologies and laboratory automation solutions. The company is also active in emerging multi-omics and AI-enabled life science tools.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.01 billion, representing a 3.48% year-over-year increase. Despite negative net profits attributable to shareholders (around RMB -600 million), the company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 26.92% of revenue. The company’s total assets were about RMB 10.31 billion at year-end, with a slight decrease compared to the previous year. It maintains a global workforce of 2,604 employees and has demonstrated steady growth in sales volume and market penetration, especially in gene sequencing instrument installations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes innovation-driven life science core tools with proprietary sequencing technologies that deliver high accuracy, long read lengths, and rapid throughput at competitive costs. Its unique DNBSEQ technology reduces errors and lowers sequencing costs, while its full-read-length (SEQ ALL) product matrix covers diverse applications. Integration of AI into laboratory automation and bioinformatics accelerates data analysis and enhances operational efficiency. The company’s global localized support, comprehensive product portfolio, and strong patent portfolio provide customers with reliable, scalable, and cutting-edge solutions for research and clinical applications.
